_comment: SYNTHETIC SAMPLE. Every number and every race below is invented - this file documents the format analyze-field-draft.mjs reads, nothing more. The real dataset is field-results.json, which is gitignored and never enters the repo (see README.md, 'Where the data lives'). Build it locally with parse-zwiftpower-paste.mjs.
source: ZwiftPower category result lists for mass-start Zwift races.
privacy: Rider names, teams, ages and heart rates are deliberately NOT stored. Each row keeps only category, finishing position, finish time, average and normalised power, and the weight/height the physics needs. Rows whose weight was not published keep no weight/height and are skipped by the analysis.
columns: cat, pos, timeSec, avgW (mechanical average power), npW (normalised power), weightKg, heightCm
routeSlug: Either an app route slug (as below) or, when the event ran a route the catalog does not map by name, the numeric Zwift route ID as a string.

example-flat-crit.label: Example Flat Crit (synthetic sample - not real results)
example-flat-crit.distanceNote: zwift-data route + lead-in matches the published event distance; nothing to reconcile. When they disagree, say so here and by how much - distance enters the implied saving through v^3, so a 5% error is a ~15% power error, and an unresolved one disqualifies the race (see README.md, 'Adding a race').
